cultural.vision_reason: The image shows a fur coat with attached mittens, decorated with patchwork bands of red, green and yellow cloth — a classic style of Siberian reindeer-herding peoples such as the Khanty, consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: coat; mitten
physical.summary: A man's coat; knee-length, flared in shape.  Made from many pieces of fur; fur collar.  Fur cream and mid-brown in colour; coat also lined with fur.  Mittens stitched to sleeve ends.  Bands of red, green and yellow patchwork decorate lower half of coat, upper band 3.5 cms and lower band 7 cms deep.  Narrow strips of red and dark blue (and some yellow) tabby woollen cloth - some pieces trimmed with fur - stitched to front shoulders and at mid-point on outer sleeves; applied most densely on back of shoulders.  Thin strips of leather used as front fastenings.  A lot of fur has worn away, revealing cream-coloured skin beneath.
